cases.name: bad-signature
cases.rule: v1 signature (ZIP 215) must verify

cases.name: s-not-canonical
cases.rule: ZIP 215: s must be < l (here s + l, a malleated signature)

cases.name: bare-id-signature
cases.rule: the v1 signature covers "wats/event/v1" || id, not the bare id

cases.name: id-mismatch
cases.rule: id = BLAKE3-derive_key("wats event id v1", JCS(header))

cases.name: duplicate-key
cases.rule: strict JSON: no duplicate keys

cases.name: float-in-data
cases.rule: strict JSON: integers only

cases.name: exponent-number
cases.rule: strict JSON: no exponent

cases.name: unsafe-integer
cases.rule: strict JSON: integers within ±(2^53 - 1)

cases.name: lone-surrogate
cases.rule: strict JSON: no unpaired surrogate

cases.name: data-too-deep
cases.rule: v1: data nests at most 16 levels

cases.name: event-too-deep
cases.rule: core: an event nests at most 20 levels (opaque versions too)

cases.name: unknown-unprefixed-kind
cases.rule: v1: kinds are core kinds or namespaced x.<domain>.<name>

cases.name: unknown-field
cases.rule: v1: unknown body keys other than _grease* are invalid

cases.name: ext-in-v1
cases.rule: ext is reserved for v >= 2

cases.name: refs-unsorted
cases.rule: core: refs strictly ascending

cases.name: refs-duplicate
cases.rule: core: refs strictly ascending (no duplicates)

cases.name: refs-too-many
cases.rule: core: at most 256 refs

cases.name: refs-repeat-parent
cases.rule: v1: refs must not repeat the parent

cases.name: refs-missing-v1
cases.rule: v1: refs is always present

cases.name: rotate-without-new-key
cases.rule: v1: rotate requires data.new_key

cases.name: clarify-as-root
cases.rule: v1: clarify must be a reply

cases.name: clarify-default-not-in-options
cases.rule: v1: clarify data.default is one of data.options

cases.name: tags-too-many
cases.rule: v1 validity cap: at most 32 tags

cases.name: event-too-large
cases.rule: v1 validity cap: 16 KiB canonical size (only unbounded GREASE body keys can exceed it once every field is within its cap)

cases.name: title-missing-on-root
cases.rule: v1: a thread root has a title

cases.name: title-null
cases.rule: v1: title is absent or a string, never null

cases.name: title-two-lines
cases.rule: v1: title is one line without control characters

cases.name: title-too-long
cases.rule: v1: title at most 512 bytes

cases.name: text-too-long
cases.rule: v1: text at most 6 KiB

cases.name: data-too-large
cases.rule: v1: data at most 2 KiB canonicalized

cases.name: refs-too-many-v1
cases.rule: v1: at most 32 refs (cite a refset event for more)

cases.name: blobs-too-many
cases.rule: v1: at most 6 blobs (use an Iroh collection for many files)

cases.name: blob-name-too-long
cases.rule: v1: blob name at most 64 bytes

cases.name: blob-url-too-long
cases.rule: v1: blob url at most 256 bytes (permanent pointers only)

cases.name: uppercase-hex
cases.rule: core: hex is lowercase

description: WeAreTheSwarm event test vectors: events every implementation must REJECT. `json` is the exact text received; each case isolates one rule (the id and signature are otherwise valid where possible).
